# P31.18 — Resolution eval from first principles + rules v3 (P31)

- **Semantic id:** `EVAL.1` · **Phase:** 31 · **Kind:** skeleton · **Tag:** p31-followups · **Wave:** gated tail
- **base_branch:** (set when fleshed out; stacks on the then-current chain tip) · **Depends on:** P31.17 (HUMAN-H4 dispositioned), P31.11

> **Skeleton only — gated on `HUMAN-H4` (P31.17).** Written in full after the human review campaign is recorded.
> Do not run.

## Scope (one line)
Re-derive the auto-vs-human resolution balance from a **human** holdout: re-estimate P/R/F1 + B-cubed + LLM-vs-human κ,
re-tune `auto_write_precision_threshold` and the tier cutoffs (and consider a decision-theoretic loss where a false
merge costs more than a false split), and derive camera-site **rules v3** (name-level device-kind/place soft
conflicts) from training data measured on that fresh human holdout. Record it in a **new ADR** (ADR-R9-EVAL, never a
silent threshold edit). Drop the PROVISIONAL disclosure only if the human eval supports it.

It also runs the hosted camera-sites re-run (`materialize.sh --apply run camera-sites`, a Cloud Run job) so the
campaign's accepted decisions cluster (N drops per accept, re-run +0). That closes D-P30.2b-1 against its own
verification rule.
